name: Wandering Relics: Rites of the Wandering Soul - Halloween Special
source:
"Give me your name…"
A voice calls from the dark, patient and older than memory.

You awaken in a candlelit room as the veil between the living and the dead grows thin. A stranger waits beyond the shadows. He has prepared eight ancient rites, each carrying a question you may not be ready to answer.

Wandering Relics: Rites of the Wandering Soul - Halloween Special is a short Gothic horror / Dark Romance visual novel set against a 1935 Art Deco backdrop. Face a red-eyed yandere moth creature, uncover forgotten truths, and experience an atmospheric Halloween spin-off featuring an original remastered soundtrack and multiple endings.

This is a standalone story—no prior knowledge of the main game is required to fully enjoy it.

[From [url=https://2kaystudioofficial.itch.io/wandering-relics-halloween-special]itch.io[/url]]
